# Inlang message-format plugin

Vendored from the official `@inlang/plugin-message-format` package, version 4.6.0, MIT licensed. Original distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@inlang/plugin-message-format@4.6.0/dist/index.js

The unmodified bundle is used through `project.inlang/settings.json` so local builds do not require CDN access. See `LICENSE` in this directory. Update deliberately and verify all compiled message exports after a version change.
